title: Fukuyama, Thiel, and the Revenge of the Last Man
gist: Benn Steil reviews Francis Fukuyama's new memoir 'In the Realm of the Last Man', in which Fukuyama tries to redeem his end-of-history thesis by stressing its warning that liberal democracy could break down from internal stresses. Steil argues Peter Thiel's quest to escape government oversight and wrest control of the future from democratic majorities mocks Fukuyama's argument anew.
